title: auth_throttles
description: Failed-login counters per normalised email (UA-24). A row is kept even for an email with no account, so a lock never reveals existence; for that reason the key is subjectHash, a salted hash of the normalised email (the salt is a server secret held by the caller), never the address itself. 5 failures in 15 min lock the subject for 15 min, each further lock doubles up to 24 h (lockCount drives the schedule); a success or an admin unlock clears the lock state. purgeAt (BSON Date, at least 24 h after the last activity and never before lockedUntil) drives the TTL index so counters expire on their own.

subjectHash.description: Salted hash of the normalised email; unique per tenant.
